features.quote: Repeat until Meltdown or Token Limit.
If the model repeats the exact same code 3 times, terminate the loop
features.justification_quote: it is stuck, not melting down

features.quote: The harness keeps the context window just large enough to maintain the "illusion" of the previous failure.
features.justification_quote: If the context is too long, the model drifts; if too short, it forgets the frustration.
